svg.text: HOW TO USE THE 3-IN-1 DRAWER INSTALLATION JIGS
Bambu Stand 3D Printer Storage Workbench • 18" Full-Extension Slides • 1/2" Birch Boxes • 3/4" Walnut Faces

g.text: JIG 1: SLIDE SETBACK CRADLE (CABINET CARCASS MOUNTING)
Slide butts against this stop (recessed behind frame)
JIG 2: DRAWER BOX MOUNTING BLOCKS (BENCH ASSEMBLY)
• Gives 1/4" bottom clearance so screws never rub!
USE BOTH BLOCKS: One at front, one at rear of drawer box
(Fastened from inside drawer box with 1" screws)
• Inserts into gap on all 4 sides
• Pull tabs allow quick removal after clamping!

text.tspan: Hook the Setback Cradle over front 2x4 leg. Rest 18" outer slide on shelf
against the 2.5mm stop. Drive front screw through open window, level slide
to the rear, and drive rear mounting screws.

g.text: Mount Slide Rails to Drawer Boxes (Jig 2)

text.tspan: Set 1/2" Birch drawer box on the bench. Place the pair of Mounting Blocks
under the slide rail. Drive screws into the side of the box. Automatically sets
exact 1/4" bottom clearance so slide hardware never rubs.

g.text: Click Drawer Box into Cabinet & Test Glide

text.tspan: Align drawer box rails into cabinet slide tracks and push firmly until the
soft-close mechanism clicks. Test the full 18" extension to verify buttery-smooth,
Insert four 1/8" Reveal Shims into perimeter gaps. Clamp Walnut face
to drawer box with Quick-Grip clamps. Drive 1" wood screws from inside the
drawer box into the back of Walnut face. Pull out shims!
Pre-drill drawer face screw holes from inside the box with a 1/8" bit and
depth tape flag (set to 1" total depth) to ensure screws never poke through Walnut!
